expected_diagnosis: Kernel OOM killer terminated app process.
recommended_next_checks: free -h; memory peak / cgroup limits / logs
resolution_guidance: Tune heap/process count or resource allocation with owner.
verification: No OOM kills under equivalent workload.
escalate_when: Requires capacity changes or code fix.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
